title: Applies-To Scope
description: Scopes a search_rule or putaway_rule. Allowed combinations: {item_id}, {owner, category}, {owner}, {category}. Omit applies_to entirely for the building's default rule. Precedence, most specific first: item_id > owner + category > owner > category > default (see tools/precedence.py). Two rules of the same kind with the same scope are rejected by tools/validate.py.

item_id.description: References an item id in MasterData-as-Code. The item already belongs to exactly one owner and one category, so item_id stands alone.

owner.description: References an owner id in MasterData-as-Code company.yaml owners. Only for multi-owner warehouses.

category.description: References a category id in MasterData-as-Code.
